content: If multiple operations are mapped to the same RunnableEntity , and [SWS_Rte_04522] requires a call serialization, then the operation invoked events shall be mapped to same task and they shall have the same position in task. Otherwise the RTE Generator shall reject configuration.

If multiple operations are mapped to the same RunnableEntity , and [SWS_Rte_04522] requires a call serialization, then the operation invoked events shall be mapped to same task and they shall have the same position in task. Otherwise the RTE Generator shall reject configuration.

If multiple operations are mapped to the same RunnableEntity and that RunnableEntity requires call serialization (i.e its canBeInvokedConcur- rently attribute is set to FALSE), but the related RteEventToTaskMapping s allow the called server runnable to either be called in parallel or called re-entrantly the RTE Generator shall reject the configuration.
